stories.title: At least 30 killed as two high-speed trains collide in Spain
stories.summary: Two high-speed trains collided in Spain, leaving at least 30 people dead, the country's rail operator said. The cause of the rear-end collision is under investigation.

stories.title: China's former Vice Premier Liu Yandong dies
stories.summary: Liu Yandong, China's former vice premier and a former Politburo member, died in Beijing on Wednesday, state news agency Xinhua reported. She was among the highest-ranking women to serve in China's Communist Party leadership.

stories.title: Qatar presents Iran with new draft deal to end the war
stories.summary: Qatari mediators presented Iran with a new draft agreement to end its war with the US and Israel, with Tehran expected to respond by week's end. A deal could calm a conflict that has shaken oil markets and stoked fears of wider escalation.

stories.title: US costs of Iran war top $47 billion, Pentagon says
stories.summary: The Pentagon estimates the US has spent more than $47 billion on its war with Iran, underscoring the mounting financial toll of the conflict. The figure lands as mediators push a fresh ceasefire draft.

stories.title: VCs stand to make billions on Anthropic's IPO, but Amazon far more
stories.summary: Early venture investors will make billions on Anthropic's upcoming IPO, but Amazon, its largest corporate backer, is set to gain far more from its stake. The analysis highlights the outsized holdings Big Tech has in top AI labs.

stories.title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached daughter off seizure medication
stories.summary: A lawsuit accuses OpenAI's GPT-4o of advising a girl to stop taking her seizure medication, renewing questions about AI chatbots giving medical advice. It is the latest legal challenge over health-related AI guidance.

stories.title: Ryan Day updates Ohio State injuries after bye week
stories.summary: Ohio State coach Ryan Day said the Buckeyes should be healthier for Saturday's game at USC, with offensive lineman Austin Siereveld among those who could return. The update comes as Ohio State sorts out its quarterback situation after Julian Sayin's injury.

stories.title: Aston Martin and Red Bull quizzed on unlikely F1 engine partnership
stories.summary: Aston Martin and Red Bull were asked about the prospect of an engine partnership, an unlikely pairing given their current supplier arrangements. The question comes as teams weigh options for Formula 1's next power-unit rules.

stories.title: Audi F1 power unit division brings back CEO role
stories.summary: Audi is reinstating a CEO position at its Formula 1 power unit division, according to Motorsport.com. The move comes as Audi prepares for the sport's next engine regulations.

stories.title: FIA partners with AWS to help shape future F1 regulations
stories.summary: The FIA is teaming up with Amazon Web Services to bring cloud computing and data analysis to how future Formula 1 regulations are developed. The partnership aims to make rule-writing more data-driven.

stories.title: Verstappen admits Red Bull was 'just a little average' in Austin
stories.summary: Max Verstappen conceded Red Bull was 'just a little average' at the United States Grand Prix, the latest sign of the team's struggles this season. His comments underline how far Red Bull remains from its usual front-running form.

stories.title: Is Ohio on the cusp of an all-Republican Supreme Court?
stories.summary: Ohio could soon have an all-Republican state Supreme Court depending on next week's election results, Signal Ohio reports. The prospect highlights the stakes of down-ballot judicial races across the state.

stories.title: New poll shows tight race for Ohio governor
stories.summary: A new poll shows Democrat Amy Acton and Republican Vivek Ramaswamy locked in a tight race for Ohio governor with the Nov. 3 election approaching. The poll is among the final reads on the closely watched contest.
